entities.name: Bernard Stewart, 3rd Lord of Aubigny

entities.summary: Bernard Stewart, 3rd Seigneur d'Aubigny was a French soldier, commander of the Garde Écossaise, and diplomat belonging to the Scottish family of Stewart of Darnley.
